description.fun: Lunatone was first found where a meteorite had fallen, and one theory says it came from outer space. It lives in caves and becomes active under the full moon, and its health rises and falls with the moon's phases. Its red eyes can paralyse a foe with fear or send it to sleep. Its partner, Solrock, draws its power from the sun instead.
description.guide: A Rock- and Psychic-type Pokémon shaped like a crescent moon, thought to have come from space, which floats using psychic power. It is the counterpart of Solrock. It does not evolve.
description.tagline: A crescent-moon meteorite that waxes and wanes with the moon
